parts.label: Definition
parts.text:
SELECT o.id AS order_id,
    c.name AS customer,
    o.status,
    COALESCE(sum(((i.quantity)::numeric * i.unit_price)), (0)::numeric) AS items_total
   FROM ((orders o
     JOIN customers c ON ((c.id = o.customer_id)))
     LEFT JOIN order_items i ON ((i.order_id = o.id)))
  GROUP BY o.id, c.name, o.status;
